entries.name: travel_story
entries.description: Stages a reviewed personal Story destination in the ordinary atomic event settlement.

entries.name: start_combat
entries.description: Begins an ephemeral server-controlled fight and yields validated snapshots until a terminal result.

entries.name: combat_result
entries.description: Reads only the server-computed fight outcome for this event run.

entries.name: start_challenge
entries.description: Starts a registered server-validated timed-input challenge.

entries.name: challenge_result
entries.description: Returns the server-validated outcome of the challenge in the current event run.

entries.name: advance_story_time
entries.description: Advances personal Story time to a reviewed waiting target at successful settlement.

entries.name: record_game_day
entries.description: Records the authoritative calendar day in a named progress value for daily reward deduplication.

entries.name: record_game_minute
entries.description: Records the authoritative personal Story minute as transactional progress for delayed appointments. Uses whole UTC minutes, not browser timestamps.

entries.name: play_mode
entries.description: Reads the character's authoritative personal play mode pinned at event start.

entries.name: opening_completed
entries.description: Reads whether the authoritative opening completed in this play context.

entries.name: game_day
entries.description: Returns the authoritative UTC calendar day ordinal since 1970 for exact daily reward records, including through Yarn's float32 numbers.

entries.name: game_minute
entries.description: Returns the authoritative whole UTC calendar minute ordinal, within Yarn's exact integer range, for personal Story appointments.

entries.name: native_value
entries.description: Reads an original native bank address (2:832) or saved scene parameter byte (01c7:2) from the event's pinned dialogue snapshot.

entries.name: set_native_value
entries.description: Stages an original native value in the same transaction as rewards. Banks 2 and 3 accept 0 or 1; bank 4 and the 32 saved 01c7 parameter bytes accept 0..255.

entries.name: flag_set
entries.description: Returns whether a named story flag is set.

entries.name: progress_value
entries.description: Returns a named conversation or story progress value.

entries.name: has_item
entries.description: Returns whether the character owns at least the requested item quantity.

entries.name: yen
entries.description: Returns the authoritative character yen balance.

entries.name: actor_present
entries.description: Returns whether an actor is currently resident in the room.

entries.name: in_scene
entries.description: Returns whether the player is in the named scene.

entries.name: game_hour
entries.description: Returns the authoritative in-game hour.

entries.name: game_date_on_or_after
entries.description: Returns whether the authoritative in-game month and day are on or after the supplied calendar date.

entries.name: random_integer
entries.description: Returns a uniformly selected authoritative integer in the inclusive range.

entries.name: actor_in_bounds
entries.description: Tests an actor against a catalogued authored spatial region.

entries.name: set_flag
entries.description: Sets a named story flag in the event transaction.

entries.name: clear_flag
entries.description: Clears a named story flag in the event transaction.

entries.name: set_progress
entries.description: Writes a named conversation or story progress value in the event transaction.

entries.name: increment_progress
entries.description: Adds a positive finite amount to a named conversation or story progress value in the event transaction.

entries.name: give_item
entries.description: Adds an item to the authoritative character inventory on commit.

entries.name: remove_item
entries.description: Removes an item from the authoritative character inventory on commit.

entries.name: grant_yen
entries.description: Adds yen to the authoritative character balance on commit.

entries.name: spend_yen
entries.description: Atomically spends yen or fails the event branch.

entries.name: play_player_motion
entries.description: Plays a catalogued player motion under event ownership.

entries.name: look_at_actor
entries.description: Gives an actor an event-owned look target and waits for client to apply it.

entries.name: clear_actor_look
entries.description: Releases the event-owned look target and waits for client to apply the release.

entries.name: start_camera
entries.description: Starts a catalogued authored camera preset.

entries.name: stop_camera
entries.description: Stops the event camera and restores the previous camera owner.

entries.name: play_sequence
entries.description: Runs a catalogued authored presentation sequence whose internal timing or overlap cannot be represented as ordered dialogue commands.

entries.name: start_activity
entries.description: Runs a registered presentation-only specialized activity and waits for its client cleanup acknowledgment. It cannot authorize a gameplay result or durable state.

entries.name: pass_trigger
entries.description: Before any player-visible yield, commits explicitly staged gate state and continues trigger dispatch with the next lower-priority candidate.

entries.name: complete
entries.description: Completes the event and commits its staged durable state.
